lines.text: Hello, this message is for Mr. Lucas Bennett. My name is Hannah Price, and I'm calling from the front desk of the Coral Point Resort. When our housekeeping team cleaned your room this morning after you checked out, they found a black jacket in the closet. We believe it belongs to you.

We are keeping the jacket in a safe place at the front desk for now. Please call us back before Friday to let us know if you would like to pick it up or have it sent to your home address. Thank you, and have a nice day.

lines.text: Attention, please. Welcome to the Greenfield Family Clinic. Starting today, patients with an appointment can check in using the new touch screens next to the main entrance. Simply enter your name and date of birth, and the screen will print a waiting number for you. If you need help, our reception staff will be happy to show you how it works.

Please also note that the pharmacy counter will close early today, at four p.m., so that our staff can count the medicine in stock. If you need to pick up a prescription, please go to the counter before that time. Thank you for your patience.

lines.text: Need a break from the busy city? This month, the Lotus Bay Hotel is offering a special weekend package for families. Stay two nights in a spacious garden room and enjoy a full breakfast each morning. Children under twelve can eat for free in all of our restaurants.

Guests who book the package will also receive a free boat trip to the nearby islands. But hurry, this offer is only available until the end of October. To reserve your room, call our booking team and mention the word Sunshine to receive a fifteen percent discount.

lines.text: Good morning, this is Mark Ellison with the traffic report on City Radio. Drivers heading to the airport should expect long delays this morning. A truck has broken down on Ocean Road near the Central Bridge, and two lanes are closed. Police say the road should be clear by ten o'clock.

Until then, drivers are asked to use Hill Street instead. Also, remember that the night market opens again this weekend, so parking in the town center will be difficult on Saturday. If possible, please take the bus. I'll be back with another update in thirty minutes.

lines.text: Before we finish, I have an update on our move to the fifth floor. We were planning to move next Monday, but the company that is supplying our new desks has told us that the delivery will be two weeks late. So the move will now take place at the beginning of next month.

I realize many of you have already packed your things. Well, you'll be working out of boxes a little longer. In the meantime, Olivia from technical support will visit each team this week to check which computers need new cables. Please make a list of any equipment problems and send it to her by Thursday.

questions.stem: What is the speaker mainly discussing?
options: A change to a relocation schedule
questions.why_th: ผู้พูดบอกว่าการย้ายไปชั้นห้าต้องเลื่อนเพราะโต๊ะใหม่มาช้า relocation คือการย้ายที่ทำงาน จึงตอบ A ส่วน C เป็นกับดักเพราะเรื่อง computers เป็นแค่รายละเอียดเล็กๆ ตอนท้าย

lines.text: Good afternoon, students. This is an announcement from the Westfield College library. Because final exams begin next week, the library will stay open until midnight from Monday to Friday. The group study rooms are very popular at this time of year, so you will need to reserve them in advance at the information desk on the ground floor.

Each group may use a room for up to three hours a day. Please remember to bring your student card, because you will not be allowed into the building after eight p.m. without it. We wish you all the best of luck with your exams.

lines.text: Welcome to your first day at the Silver Sands Hotel. My name is Maria Lopez, and I'm the head of the housekeeping department. This morning, I'll show you around the building so that you know where everything is. We'll start in the laundry room in the basement, where clean towels and sheets are kept.

After that, I'll give each of you a cart and a key card for the rooms on your floor. Please keep your key card with you at all times. At twelve o'clock, we'll have lunch together in the staff dining room. Then, in the afternoon, you'll practice making beds in one of our guest rooms.

lines.text: Hi, Ms. Novak, this is Tom Baker from the reception desk at Northgate Design. I'm calling about your job interview with our office manager, which was planned for Wednesday morning. Unfortunately, she has to travel to meet a client that day, so we'd like to move your interview to Thursday at two p.m.

When you arrive, please come to the reception desk on the third floor and show a form of photo identification, so that we can print a visitor pass for you. Could you call me back by tomorrow to let me know if the new time works for you? Thanks, and I look forward to meeting you.

lines.text: Good afternoon, everyone, and thank you for joining this year's Customer Care Workshop. I'm pleased to introduce our next speaker, Dr. Samuel Reyes. Dr. Reyes spent fifteen years managing hotels in Asia and Europe before he began training service teams. His latest book, The Quiet Guest, explains how small changes in the way staff greet people can improve customer reviews.

I keep a copy on my desk, and I still discover something new every time I open it. After his talk, Dr. Reyes will sign copies of his book in the lobby, and there will also be time for questions. Now, please switch off your phones and join me in welcoming Dr. Reyes.
